# Tutoring With LLM Tutors

## English Abstract

We ran a randomized controlled trial (RCT) with large language model (LLM) tutors. The RCT showed gains; AI helped.

**Keywords**: LLM, RCT, tutoring

## Chinese Abstract (zh-TW)

本研究以隨機對照試驗（randomized controlled trial, RCT）檢驗大型語言模型（LLM）家教。使用RCT設計，NLP 模組未定義。

## 1. Introduction

Large language models (LLMs) are used widely. We used an RCT, a randomized controlled trial (RCT), in Phase II.
The LLM had an SD of 2.1 and the AIDS cohort was small. Water (H2O) and eGFR were measured. qPCR (quantitative polymerase chain reaction) was run.
World Health Organization [WHO] guidance (WHO, 2020) applied; Smith JA, Jones BC (2019) agreed.
